text.title: Agency Discovery Call Scorecard Procedure
text.summary: Seven steps: write the ICP criteria the fit anchors quote, set the four axes and weights, write observable anchors per axis, fix the formula and the single threshold, score each call within 24 hours with evidence and verified authority, validate, and run the weekly same-version retro that decides the next rubric version.

step.name: write-the-icp-criteria
step.input: The agency's closed-won and closed-lost deals of the last two quarters; the service lines it sells.
step.action: Write three ICP criteria (industry, size, service line) that the fit anchors will count. Open `templates/agency-discovery-call-scorecard.rubric.md.j2` and set `rubric_version`, `version_date` and `version_reason`.
step.output: ICP criteria and the rubric header.
step.decision-gate: Fewer than two discovery calls a week: stop, qualify by judgement (06-decision-tree.xml). No written ICP: it cannot be scored; write it first (r-anchors-are-observable-facts).

step.name: set-the-four-axes-and-weights
step.action: Add `axes[]` `fit`, `budget`, `urgency`, `decision_maker` with two-decimal `weight` values that sum to 1.0 and none above 0.5 (template default 0.3 / 0.3 / 0.2 / 0.2). Add a fifth axis only for a closed deal the four did not explain.
step.decision-gate: Weights do not sum to 1.0 or an axis exceeds 0.5: renormalise before writing anchors (r-four-axes-fit-budget-urgency-decision-maker, r-weights-sum-to-one-no-dominant-axis).

step.name: write-observable-anchors
step.input: The ICP criteria; the agency's minimum and typical annual contract value; its onboarding lead time.
step.action: For each axis write `anchors[]` from lowest to highest: `budget` as currency ranges per year, `urgency` as calendar windows, `decision_maker` as roles and confirmed sign-off with "authority not discussed" as the lowest, `fit` as the number of ICP criteria met.
step.decision-gate: An anchor is an adjective, or two people cannot quote the call to place a lead on it: rewrite (r-anchors-are-observable-facts).

step.name: fix-the-formula-and-threshold
step.action: Set `score_range` 0-100, write `formula` verbatim, pick one `decision_threshold` strictly inside the range (template default 60) and the `threshold_rule`. Set `retro` to weekly, same-version only, comparing `advance_rate` and `close_rate_of_advanced`.
step.decision-gate: A "maybe" band or a second threshold is proposed: collapse it to one number (r-single-threshold-inside-range, r-score-formula-0-100).

step.name: score-each-call-within-24-hours
step.action: Within 24 hours of the call, a person who was on it adds a `leads[]` entry: `call_date`, `scored_at`, `scorer_on_call: true`, `rubric_version`, and for every axis an `anchor_index` with an `evidence` note quoting the prospect. On `decision_maker` set `authority_confirmed` from what the prospect said about sign-off; if not discussed, `anchor_index: 0`. Compute `score` with the formula and set `decision` by the threshold.
step.decision-gate: Any axis has an empty evidence note, or the scorer was not on the call: the score does not count for the advance decision (r-scored-within-24h-with-evidence, r-decision-maker-scored-on-verified-authority).

step.name: validate-the-rubric-and-leads
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-agency-discovery-call-scorecard.py --file`; it checks the weight sum, recomputes every lead's score from the anchor picks, the 24-hour window, the version match and the decision against the threshold.
step.decision-gate: A score does not recompute: the anchor pick or the arithmetic is wrong, never the formula (r-score-formula-0-100).

step.name: run-the-weekly-same-version-retro
step.input: Leads scored under the current `rubric_version`; pipeline outcomes for advanced leads.
step.action: Compare advance rate and close rate of advanced leads with the previous period for the same version. If anchors or weights must change, bump `rubric_version` with `version_date` and `version_reason`; do not rescore old leads on the new version.
step.output: Retro note and, if needed, the next rubric version.
step.decision-gate: A change was made in place without a version bump: the week's comparison is discarded (r-versioned-weekly-calibration).

list.item: Rubric validates via `scripts/validate-agency-discovery-call-scorecard.py` with no violation.
Two people scoring the same recorded call land on the same anchors on every axis.
Every lead in the period has a score under one rubric version, with evidence per axis and a binary decision.
